full_judgment:
This Rule was issued on an application under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure challenging the Judgment and decree dated 3-4-2003 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, First Court, Bogra, in Partition Appeal No. 277 of 1995 dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and decree dated 28-10-1995 and 2-11-1995 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Second Court, Bogra in Partition Suit No. 248 of 1969 decreeing the suit. 

 4. The learned Munsif, Second Court, Bogra decreed the suit in respect of the suit lands described in schedule 1 (ka) and 1 (Gha) against which the petitioners preferred partition appeal No. 231 of 1986 before the learned District Judge, Bogra and the appeal was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, who by the judgment and decree, allowed the appeal, and sent back the suit on remand to the trial Court. 

 5. After remand the trial Court, by the judgment and decree dated 28-10-1995 and 2-11-1995 decreed the suit allotting a saham of 1.50 acre of land in favour of the predecessor of the opposite party Nos. 1-10 against which the petitioners preferred partition appeal No. 277 of 1995 before the learned District Judge, Bogra which was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, First Court, who by the judgment and decree dated 29-3-2003 and 3-4-2003 dismissed the appeal. 

 6. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the aforesaid judgment and decree of the appellate Court, the petitioners preferred this revisional application before this Court and obtained the present Rule. 

 In the result, the Rule discharged without any order as to cost. The decrees of the Courts below are hereby affirmed.
